description: Video Download. Credit cost: 1 credit per call.

download_type.description: Desired download type. You have three options: Default: "audio_video".

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

max_duration.description: Maximum duration of the downloaded content in seconds. If the video/audio is longer than this value, only the content up to this duration will be downloaded.

video_format.description: Desired output format for the video. Available options: Default: "mp4".

video_quality.description: Desired video quality. Available options: Default: "best".

webhook_authorization.description: Authorization header for the webhook. This parameter allows you to add authentication to your webhook endpoint. This value will be included in the Authorization header when making the webhook request to your server.

webhook_url.description: URL of the webhook where results will be sent. When specified, the system will attempt to send the response to this URL up to 3 times with a 5-second delay between each attempt. The results will be sent as a POST request.

name: video_download
